name: Meridian Feed (reporting_xyz translation, pattern_map form)
description: Same legacy Perl reporting_xyz()/mail_glob() example from docs/mailglob.txt as the older per-pattern workflow, rewritten with attachment_pattern_map_step + save_attachment_step: matches mail from feed@meridian.com addressed to a meridian.*@ recipient, opens the encrypted daily_feed.zip attachment (tries 'secret1' then 'secret2'), and copies 7 specific files out of it under renamed, date-stamped target names - all 7 pattern=>target pairs live in one attachment_pattern_map_step instead of 7 sibling foreach/attachment_pattern_step/save_attachment_step blocks. attachment_pattern_map_step matches the current attachment against the pairs in order and, on match, stores the resolved target name in context under 'matched_filename' (or stops the branch on no match); the unmodified save_attachment_step then saves using filename_template: "${matched_filename}". Use with example-data/emails/meridian_feed.eml (extracts successfully with 'secret2') or example-data/emails/meridian_feed_wrong_password.eml (all passwords fail -> nothing is saved, no crash).
